problems.quote: Source: DARPG CPGRAMS Dashboard; Annual Reports; 2nd ARC 12th Report
problems.problem: The 2nd ARC 12th Report (2009) cannot be a source for 2023-24 metrics; it is a historical document.
problems.correction: Source: DARPG CPGRAMS Dashboard; Annual Reports
problems.verifierReason: 2nd ARC 12th Report (2009) cannot supply 2023-24 metrics; removal is correct.

problems.quote: Uttar Pradesh (2015)
problems.problem: Uttar Pradesh enacted the Janhit Guarantee Act in 2011, not 2015.
problems.correction: Uttar Pradesh (2011)
problems.verifierReason: UP Janhit Guarantee Act enacted 2011, not 2015; correction accurate.

problems.quote: 9th Summit (2022)
problems.problem: The EU-India Summit in 2022 was not the 9th; the 9th Summit was held in 2009. The 2022 summit was the 17th (or 15th/16th depending on counting).
problems.correction: 2022 Summit
problems.verifierReason: EU-India 2022 summit was 17th, not 9th; 9th was 2008. Correction removes false ordinal.

problems.quote: Saudi Arabia (invited 2023, joined 2024)
problems.problem: Saudi Arabia was invited to join BRICS in 2023 but had not formally joined as of 2024.
problems.correction: Saudi Arabia (invited 2023)
problems.verifierReason: Saudi Arabia invited Aug 2023 but had not formally joined as of 2024. Correction removes false join date.

problems.quote: France hosts the ISA Secretariat in Gurugram
problems.problem: The ISA Secretariat is hosted by India in Gurugram, not France.
problems.correction: India hosts the ISA Secretariat in Gurugram
problems.verifierReason: ISA Secretariat is in Gurugram, hosted by India; correction accurate.

problems.quote: the 103rd Amendment’s 10 % EWS quota only to the extent it violated the 50 % ceiling (Jarnail Singh v. Lachhmi Narain Gupta, 2018)
problems.problem: The case Jarnail Singh v. Lachhmi Narain Gupta (2018) concerns creamy layer in SC/ST promotions, not the EWS quota. The 103rd Amendment (2019) was upheld in 2022 (Janhit Abhiyan v. Union of India) and does not violate the 50% ceiling.
problems.correction: the 103rd Amendment’s 10% EWS quota was upheld as not violating the 50% ceiling (Janhit Abhiyan v. Union of India, 2022)
problems.verifierReason: Original misattributes case; correction correctly states 103rd Amendment upheld and not violating 50% ceiling.

problems.quote: Articles 15 and 16 embody the guarantee of equality before law and equal opportunity in public employment
problems.problem: Article 15 prohibits discrimination; it does not guarantee equality before law (that is Article 14). Article 16 guarantees equality of opportunity in public employment.
problems.correction: Articles 15 and 16 embody the guarantee of non-discrimination and equal opportunity in public employment
problems.verifierReason: Original mixes Article 14 with 15; correction accurately describes non-discrimination (15) and employment equality (16).

problems.quote: most notably during the Suez Crisis of 1956 and the Korean War
problems.problem: The Uniting for Peace resolution was not invoked during the Korean War; the Security Council acted directly because the Soviet Union was boycotting. The first invocation was the Suez Crisis (1956).
problems.correction: most notably during the Suez Crisis of 1956
problems.verifierReason: Uniting for Peace (Res 377) adopted Nov 1950, after Korean War start; SC acted due to USSR boycott. First invocation was Suez 1956.

problems.quote: Supreme Court’s “trade‑secret” exception, articulated in Infosys Ltd. v. Competition Commission (2022)
problems.problem: No such Supreme Court case exists; the trade‑secret exception under RTI is based on Section 8(1)(d) and jurisprudence like CBSE v. Aditya Bandopadhyay (2011), not Infosys v. Competition Commission.
problems.correction: The RTI Act’s trade‑secret exception (Section 8(1)(d)) permits withholding commercial confidentiality subject to public interest.
problems.verifierReason: No such SC case; trade-secret exception is under RTI Sec 8(1)(d) per CBSE v. Aditya Bandopadhyay.

problems.quote: algorithmic transparency (Section 23 of DPDP Act)
problems.problem: The DPDP Act, 2023 does not contain a Section 23 on algorithmic transparency; Section 23 deals with powers to call for information.
problems.correction: algorithmic transparency (not specified in DPDP Act)
problems.verifierReason: DPDP Act Sec 23 concerns powers to call for information, not algorithmic transparency.

problems.quote: DPDP 23 demands dynamic “logic explanations.”
problems.problem: DPDP Act has no Section 23 requiring logic explanations; algorithmic transparency is not mandated by DPDP.
problems.correction: DPDP does not mandate logic explanations.
problems.verifierReason: DPDP Act has no Sec 23 mandating logic explanations; algorithmic transparency not required.

problems.quote: Supreme Court Infosys 2022
problems.problem: Refers to a non‑existent Supreme Court trade‑secret ruling; the Infosys case cited does not establish such an exception.
problems.correction: the RTI Act’s trade‑secret exception
problems.verifierReason: Non-existent SC case; correct basis is RTI Act's trade-secret exception (Sec 8(1)(d)).

problems.quote: Section 4 exemption (e.g., security)
problems.problem: Section 4 of the RTI Act concerns proactive disclosure and contains no exemptions; exemptions are under Section 8.
problems.correction: Section 8 exemption (e.g., security)
problems.verifierReason: RTI Sec 4 is proactive disclosure; exemptions are in Sec 8.

problems.quote: Supreme Court’s 2021 Uttar Pradesh v. Rajesh Kumar judgment
problems.problem: No such Supreme Court judgment exists; the case name and year appear fabricated.
problems.correction: the Supreme Court’s 2011 CBSE v. Aditya Bandopadhyay judgment
problems.verifierReason: No such 2021 SC judgment; CBSE v. Aditya Bandopadhyay (2011) is the leading case on trade secrets.

problems.quote: public hearings under Section 21 of the NGT Act, 2010
problems.problem: Section 21 of the NGT Act deals with appeals to the Supreme Court; public hearings are mandated by the EIA Notification, not the NGT Act.
problems.correction: public hearings under the EIA Notification
problems.verifierReason: NGT Act Sec 21 covers appeals to SC; public hearings are under EIA Notification.

problems.quote: annual Pravasi Bharatiya Divas (PBD) convention
problems.problem: Pravasi Bharatiya Divas has been held biennially (every two years) since 2016, not annually.
problems.correction: biennial Pravasi Bharatiya Divas (PBD) convention
problems.verifierReason: PBD was annual 2003-2015; switched to biennial in 2016. Current frequency is biennial.

problems.quote: 2015 Fortaleza Declaration
problems.problem: The Fortaleza Declaration establishing the BRICS CRA was issued in 2014, not 2015.
problems.correction: 2014 Fortaleza Declaration
problems.verifierReason: Fortaleza Declaration establishing BRICS CRA was issued in July 2014, not 2015.

problems.quote: up to 30 % of the member’s quota contribution
problems.problem: The CRA uses 'capital contribution' or 'committed amount'; 'quota' is an IMF term not used in the CRA Treaty.
problems.correction: up to 30 % of the member’s capital contribution
problems.verifierReason: CRA Treaty uses 'capital contribution', not IMF term 'quota'.

problems.quote: In March 2020, Brazil drew US $1.5 billion under the precautionary line to cushion the COVID‑19‑induced capital outflow; the swap was repaid in full by September 2021.
problems.problem: The BRICS CRA has never been activated; no member has made any drawing as of 2024.
problems.correction: No member has drawn from the CRA to date.
problems.verifierReason: BRICS CRA has never been activated; no drawings made as of 2024.

problems.quote: In July 2022, South Africa requested a US $1 billion precautionary drawing amid a terms‑of‑trade deterioration; the Standing Committee approved the request within ten days, marking the first activatio
problems.problem: No such request or approval occurred; the CRA has never been used.
problems.correction: No member has requested a drawing from the CRA.
problems.verifierReason: No formal drawing request has ever been made to the CRA.

problems.quote: first SB meeting convened in Bonn in June 2022
problems.problem: The first meeting of the Article 6.4 Supervisory Body was held 27–30 September 2022, not June 2022.
problems.correction: first SB meeting convened in Bonn in September 2022
problems.verifierReason: First Article 6.4 Supervisory Body meeting held 27–30 Sep 2022 in Bonn, not June.
